periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical-oblique orientation, with the primary axis of the patches angled inward toward the rostrum at approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a high aspect ratio where the vertical length is approximately double the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Prominent downward tapering resulting in a teardrop-like profile, with the lowest point significantly narrower than the dorsal portion of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band appears as a thick, solid block of pigment covering approximately 35-40% of the visible anterior torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral placement with a gap between the medial ear margins roughly equivalent to the width of the panda's forehead.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semicircular with a smoothly convex apex, showing no visible flattening or jagged edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish/rufous discoloration is visible on the ventral abdominal fur and extending down to the lower limbs.
